Available October 28 on EQL
2026 Topps Five Star Baseball
The names that define the game
Get notified
About the release

2026 Topps Five Star Baseball returns with six cards in every box: five on-card autographs numbered to 199 or less and one base card numbered to 50 or less. Every case also includes two autograph relics and one color-ink autograph.

Leaderboard Legend and Apex Autographs make their debut in this year’s autograph lineup. One-of-one Rookie Cap cards featuring MLB Logoman and side-logo patches from in-season hats return as a distinctive memorabilia element to this year’s release.

What to look for
Five Star Fabric

Five Star Quintuple Relic Autographs

Five Star Autographed Jumbo Prime Cards

Baseball Royalty

Who is EQL?

EQL is a third-party commerce platform that helps manage the launch of exclusive products. Topps has now partnered with EQL to help manage new launches of unique and limited-edition Topps products. EQL helps us slow down bots and to deliver a launch that is fair.

Partnering with EQL means that:

Every entry goes through a multi-step security verification process that confirms you are a human, slowing down bots from submitting orders.

One entry per person because entries are deduplicated against unique identification tags.

It should be simple to enter – once you have a verified EQL account, entering becomes a breeze.

PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING TERMS AND CONDITIONS AND PRIVACY POLICIES BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO PARTICIPATE IN AN EQL RELEASE:

* EQL’s Terms and Conditions and EQL’s Privacy Policy which govern your use of the EQL platform.* Topps.com’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Notice which govern your use of Topps.com and your entry should your entry be selected by EQL.
Learn more about the EQL draw here.
About the brand

Topps Five Star delivers a high-end collecting experience defined by elegant design, thick card stock, bold foil finishes, and premium on-card autograph content. Featuring rookies, veterans, and legends, the brand’s carefully curated checklist showcases players across generations of the game. With every card numbered, Five Star delivers an intentionally limited experience built around standout, centerpiece-worthy pulls.

2026 Bowman Football Sapphire Edition
Collect the next generation of football stars with stunning Sapphire parallels and shine.
Get notified
Download checklist
About the release

2026 Bowman Football Sapphire brings its signature mix of brilliance and exclusivity to the gridiron, transforming the 2026 Bowman Football checklist into a premium collecting experience with the unmistakable shine of Sapphire Chrome® technology. Featuring the next generation of football stars, this release puts top prospects and rising talent in the spotlight with stunning photography, vibrant colors, and eye-catching Sapphire parallels. With a checklist loaded with future stars and exciting chase opportunities, 2026 Bowman Football Sapphire delivers grail-level energy to every rip, combining Bowman's prospect-driven legacy with the premium appeal of Sapphire.

What to look for
Chrome Prospect Autographs Sapphire Edition

Base Chrome Autographs Sapphire Edition

Sapphire Selections Autographs NFL

Base Cards Rookie Autographs Sapphire Edition

About the brand

Sapphire is where premium meets precision. Known for its signature blue finish and unmistakable shine, Sapphire elevates iconic card designs into some of the Hobby’s most sought-after collectibles. Every card is designed to impress, with vibrant colors, stunning photography, and eye-catching parallels that bring the biggest stars, rising talent, and unforgettable moments to life. A Collector favorite for its sleek design, premium appeal, and exciting chase, Sapphire delivers a one-of-a-kind collecting experience that brings nothing but heat.
